# Template Cleanup Checklist

After `yarn new` scaffolding, these files MUST be deleted before any real code is written.
Run all commands in the project root.

## Backend Plugin Cleanup

```bash
# TodoListService demo — ALWAYS generated by backend-plugin template
rm -rf plugins/<id>-backend/src/services

# Template test fixture (re-generates when needed)
# Keep: plugins/<id>-backend/src/plugin.test.ts (rewrite with real tests later)
# Keep: plugins/<id>-backend/src/router.test.ts (rewrite with real tests later)
```

## Frontend Plugin Cleanup

```bash
# Example components — ALWAYS generated by frontend-plugin template
rm -rf plugins/<id>/src/components/ExampleComponent
rm -rf plugins/<id>/src/components/ExampleFetchComponent

# Template dev entry files — remove if not doing local dev
rm -f plugins/<id>/dev/index.tsx
rm -f plugins/<id>-backend/dev/index.ts

# Template test fixtures
# Keep: plugins/<id>/src/plugin.test.ts (rewrite with real tests later)
```

## Web Library Cleanup

```bash
# Example hook — ALWAYS generated by web-library template
rm -rf plugins/<id>-react/src/hooks/useExample

# Example component
rm -rf plugins/<id>-react/src/components/ExampleComponent
```

## Verification

```bash
# After cleanup, these should return ZERO results:
find plugins/<id>* -path "*Example*" 2>/dev/null
find plugins/<id>* -path "*TodoList*" 2>/dev/null
find plugins/<id>* -path "*useExample*" 2>/dev/null

# Generated directories should be empty or non-existent:
[ -d plugins/<id>/src/components ] || echo "MISSING components directory — create it"
[ -d plugins/<id>-backend/src/service ] || echo "MISSING service directory — create it"
```
